step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled inverter pair representing an SRAM cell, but with one internal storage node shorted to ground due to extraction artifacts. It includes a virtual ground node (VDDL) intended for leakage reduction.

paper_reference.title: 90% Write Power-Saving SRAM Using Sense-Amplifying Memory Cell

static_power.description: Static power consumption of the cell in hold state

paper_reported.value: Two orders of magnitude reduction in leakage

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD * I_leakage. With VDD=1.8V and I_leakage ~ 10pA for OFF transistors, Power ~ 18pW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical OFF-state leakage of SKY130 devices at room temperature. The shorted node forces the cell into a fixed state where leakage is dominated by XM2 and XM6.

node_n1_voltage.description: Voltage at the unshorted internal storage node

sky130_expected.calculation: Pulled up to VDD by XM1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM1 is fully ON (Vgs = -1.8V) and no DC path to ground exists from N1, so it should sit exactly at VDD.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the static operating point and leakage power of the extracted SRAM cell using a dummy transient analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SRAM Cell Static Leakage Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xmacc=5u L_xmacc=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N1 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XMACC GND GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmacc} w={W_xmacc}
XM4 N1 GND VDDL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND N1 VDDL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 GND VDD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVDDL VDDL 0 0.0

.control
tran 1n 10n

meas tran v_n1_avg avg v(N1) from=2n to=8n
meas tran i_leakage_avg avg -i(VVDD) from=2n to=8n

let static_power = i_leakage_avg * 1.8
print static_power

quit
.endc
.end
